The '''Imperial Production Laboratories''' was a secret location based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rigoron]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sodarra]] claimed to have originally been transporting a prototype [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]] to the facility when he and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] decided to defect.
